crossRefs.note: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat…
I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because…
David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night on the ground.
All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed…
He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.
translations.bsb: Then Job stood up, tore his robe, and shaved his head. He fell to the ground and worshiped,
translations.kjv: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
translations.asv: Then Job arose, and rent his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped;
